About Me•Academic & Professional Background

Teran Rathnayake.

IT Undergraduate at SLIIT City Uni • Co-Founder @ LA'CEDRA

I am an undergraduate student in Information Technology at SLIIT City Uni, currently enrolled in Year 2 Semester 2 of the Higher Diploma in Information Technology (February 2025 Batch).

My educational foundation took shape over eight formative years at Prince of Wales College in Moratuwa, where I actively participated in the Astronomy, New Inventor's, Aeronautical, and Athletics societies. Following school, I completed professional diplomas in both Information Technology and English at IMBS Green Campus to broaden my technical fluency and communication standards before entering university.

Alongside my university studies, I co-founded LA'CEDRA, an IT-focused organization where we build custom web applications, business management portals, and Point-of-Sale (POS) solutions for commercial clients.
